title: Unit Event — Cheer With My Heart!

meta.Outline: MORE MORE JUMP! has received an invitation to the Lumina Grand Prix, an idol TV program organized by Ms. Arisawa. At the orientation, the legendary idol speaks of the idea of a "true idol", which resonates with Airi.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line:
Thank you all for your patience!
I've finished registering us, so let's make our way inside.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thank you for taking care of that, Saito.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Not a problem! Still, this orientation event is bigger than I was anticipating...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Same here. I'm seeing a lot of reporters and photographers, not just the idols and staff.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I guess it means the Lumina Grand Prix is just that big a deal.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I see... The members of ReLight and Cheerful * Days are also here.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah. That was probably to be expected, but...
I'm Hikarin, the biggest idol in the galaxy☆ My smile has the power to brighten up the entire universe!

rows.Speaker: Hikarin
rows.Line: All you reporters out there better get pictures of me now, because I might just end up this competition's dark-horse winner!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Is she new? It's nice how peppy she is.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: D-Do you think we should introduce ourselves like that too...?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: No need for that, so try to calm down.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
(There really are all sorts of different idols here...
Some from the underground scene, and plenty of others I'm seeing for the first time. They're all unique, from their personalities to their experience level.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (The only thing we all have in common is that we were sent invitations by Ms. Arisawa...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: So, your true identity is the legendary idol, Hinako Arisawa...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: And you're organizing a program called the Lumina Grand Prix...?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (“A program that decides who the best idols are.”)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (In other words, we'd be competing against other idols to see who's number one.)

rows.Speaker: Arisawa
rows.Line: I apologize if I startled all of you.

rows.Speaker: Arisawa
rows.Line: But I'd appreciate it very much if you all attended the orientation session and heard more.

rows.Speaker: Arisawa
rows.Line: Yes. It should give MORE MORE JUMP! a chance to see whether or not this program's goals align with your own.

rows.Speaker: Arisawa
rows.Line: I'd like for you to have that opportunity before you make a decision.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Our goal as a group is to spread more hope than anyone else...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (We've been doing everything we can up until now to make that happen.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (While that's led to offers trickling back in, there's no denying that we're still in a tough spot...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (So, we need to see if this is our opportunity to turn things around.)

rows.Speaker: Arisawa
rows.Line: Thank you all for being here today.

rows.Speaker: Arisawa
rows.Line: My name is Hinako Arisawa, and I'm the organizer of this program. I hope this orientation proves fruitful for you all.

rows.Speaker: Arisawa
rows.Line: At any rate, I'll jump right in by explaining what the Lumina Grand Prix is all about.

rows.Speaker: Arisawa
rows.Line: The overall concept is “a program that decides who the best idols are.”

rows.Speaker: Arisawa
rows.Line: I'm sure many of you are here today because you were drawn to that thought.

rows.Speaker: Arisawa
rows.Line: As a television program, the Lumina Grand Prix is a competition between idols all striving for the top...

rows.Speaker: Arisawa
rows.Line: But that's all set up for the viewers' entertainment. It is not the true goal of this program.

rows.Speaker: Arisawa
rows.Line: Before we move to the finer details, I'd like to first discuss why I decided to create this program...

rows.Speaker: Arisawa
rows.Line: I'm hoping to bring out the “true idols” in each of you. For everyone in the country... No, for everyone around the world to see.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
(Around the world...?
Also, what did she mean by “true idols”...?)

rows.Speaker: Arisawa
rows.Line: That being said, I'm sure this is a bit confusing for you all.

rows.Speaker: Arisawa
rows.Line: So, I'd like to tell you a little story...

rows.Speaker: Arisawa
rows.Line: In another life, I had the honor of being an idol. Just like all of you. I admired my seniors very much, and a thought occurred to me while chasing after them...

rows.Speaker: Arisawa
rows.Line: Idols have the power to become the “light” that their fans look towards.

rows.Speaker: Arisawa
rows.Line: All of you have probably realized by now that not everything in this world can be fun and games.

rows.Speaker: Arisawa
rows.Line: Sometimes, no matter how hard you try, things don't go your way. Your work goes unrewarded.

rows.Speaker: Arisawa
rows.Line: I'm sure that some of you were pushed to the point of wanting to give it all up for good.

rows.Speaker: Arisawa
rows.Line: After I made my debut, I struggled to gain any traction. Everything I did seemed to go to waste. I felt like giving up on many occasions...

rows.Speaker: Arisawa
rows.Line: But each time, my seniors gave me a bit of hope.

rows.Speaker: Arisawa
rows.Line:
Their shows were always so dazzling...
I couldn't help but smile every time I saw them perform.

rows.Speaker: Arisawa
rows.Line:
Even after they finished performing...
Their behavior backstage, in green rooms and in their personal lives...

rows.Speaker: Arisawa
rows.Line: They were always smiling and spreading hope to fans and staff alike.

rows.Speaker: Arisawa
rows.Line: No matter how tired they were... No matter what was bothering them or causing them pain, they kept looking ahead with a smile.

rows.Speaker: Arisawa
rows.Line:
Their auras were blinding...
So much so that I didn't want to give up. I decided that I was going to be just like them.

rows.Speaker: Arisawa
rows.Line: They lit up not only my heart, but the hearts of a great many fans.

rows.Speaker: Arisawa
rows.Line: That is why I think true idols are those who can spread hope simply by being who they are.

rows.Speaker: Arisawa
rows.Line: And most importantly, they must have hearts full of persistent optimism. That is my solemn belief.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (They need to have heart... That sounds like...)

rows.Speaker: Arisawa
rows.Line: I'm sorry if my story ended up being a little long.

rows.Speaker: Arisawa
rows.Line: Anyway, I'll begin explaining what competing in the Lumina Grand Prix actually involves.

rows.Speaker: Arisawa
rows.Line:
This competition consists of two parts—
The prelim stage and the final stage.

rows.Speaker: Arisawa
rows.Line: Considering the nature of this program, you'll be told the rules of each stage while we're on the air.

rows.Speaker: Arisawa
rows.Line: Next, regarding how it will be broadcast...

rows.Speaker: Arisawa
rows.Line: Everything from practice sessions to the time you spend preparing will all be streamed live online.

rows.Speaker: Arisawa
rows.Line: People will not only be watching your stage performances, but also the way you live day to day.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Because “true idols” spread hope simply by being who they are...?

rows.Speaker: Arisawa
rows.Line: In addition, the most important moments will be broadcast on television. That includes the announcement of any results, as well as your actual performances.

rows.Speaker: Arisawa
rows.Line: With regards to the final stage, that will be broadcast around the world on NetParadise.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: It's going to be broadcast on TV and NetParadise...?

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line:
On NetParadise...
The biggest streaming service in the world...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Th-This is way bigger than I imagined. My head's starting to spin...

rows.Speaker: Arisawa
rows.Line: Until now, NetParadise has never carried an idol program such as this.

rows.Speaker: Arisawa
rows.Line: However, by showing them how idols are a unique part of Japanese culture, we convinced them to come on board.

rows.Speaker: Arisawa
rows.Line: My hope is to introduce this country's idol culture to the world, as well as your brilliance.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (She wants us to spread hope to the entire world...)

rows.Speaker: Arisawa
rows.Line: Next, I'll be going over the schedule, as well as the process for participating in this competition. I ask that you all please take a look at the papers we handed out...

rows.Speaker: Arisawa
rows.Line: Now, to finish... My hope is that through this program, you'll all be able to shine even more brightly as true idols...

rows.Speaker: Arisawa
rows.Line:
And become that light.
Become beacons of hope that so many people will look towards.

rows.Speaker: Arisawa
rows.Line: Those who wish to achieve that goal are more than welcome to enter.

rows.Speaker: Arisawa
rows.Line: As an idol fan myself, I'll be looking forward to seeing your brilliance.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Th-That totally blew me away...!
The Lumina Grand Prix's super gigantic!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes...
It's a much grander event than I initially realized...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Ms. Arisawa said she wanted us to become the light people will look towards.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That's right in line with our goal of spreading as much hope as we can.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah! Not only that, she wants us to spread that light to people all around the world.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: No idol worth their salt would wanna pass up this chance!

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: As she explained it, I felt that this program was perfect for all of you as well!

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line:
But there's also risk involved...
From what I understand, you'll be bound to it for a very long time. Plus, everything is going to be livestreamed, so you can't edit your way out of trouble.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But we're used to just being ourselves.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: That's how we do our streams all the time!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Also, even if we do have to push ourselves a bit, it should be worth the cost.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: This is a huge opportunity for MORE MORE JUMP! to get out of our bind.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I agree. If we do manage to make it to the final stage, people around the world will learn about MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: If we want to make our dream a reality, then there's no reason for us not to enter.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Looks like we're all in agreement.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It's safe to say our future hangs on this competition.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: So, in order to spread hope to as many people as we can, and to make our dream come true, let's go at this with everything we have!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Wow...! I don't think any of us realized the Lumina Grand Prix would be such a big competition.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: By the scale of the program, as well as the number of entrants. Also, the thought that went into it. Everything went beyond our expectations...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: The thought that went into it?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! Ms. Arisawa said it herself.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Idols can become the light that helps people move forward during tough times.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: And she wants us to shine for them on this program!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
So that they can move forward...
That goes perfectly with what you've all been trying to do as idols.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah, that's why we decided to enter.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Right. Personally, a lot of the things Ms. Arisawa said really hit home with me.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hmm... There really were a lot of things, but the part that resonated with me the most was her story about what it means to have an idol's heart.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Because I've always wanted to have heart and give hope to as many people as I can!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. You have been saying that for as long as I can remember, Airi.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Come to think of it, why is that?
What made you focus on having heart?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, I wanna ask the same question!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Well, in that case...
I think it's story time.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It would've been when I was still a third grader.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I wanted to dazzle everyone like the idols I saw on TV...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: So, I decided to start working towards becoming an idol myself.

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Airi
rows.Line:
Ta-daa!
What do you think? Does it suit me?

rows.Speaker: Airi's Mother
rows.Line:
Oh, you look adorable!
It even makes you seem a little more grown-up.

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Airi
rows.Line: Light blue is in right now, so I tried adding that for a more grown-up combination!

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Airi
rows.Line:
And this pleated skirt is key too!
The hem's a little short, so it...elongates my legs, right?

rows.Speaker: Airi's Mother
rows.Line:
Hehe. Where did you learn that...?
You must've been studying fashion quite a bit lately.

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Airi
rows.Line: Yup! That's because idols need to look fashionable and stylish!

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Airi
rows.Line: Anyway, Mom, I wanna ask a favor.

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Airi
rows.Line: I want you to let me audition for something!

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Airi
rows.Line: I heard that they're forming a sister group for Afternoon Girls.

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Airi
rows.Line: And I wanna try to become a member!

rows.Speaker: Airi's Mother
rows.Line:
Oh, Afternoon Girls...?
They're the group that's been on TV quite a lot lately, yes? Aren't they incredibly popular?

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Airi
rows.Line: Yeah! That's why being a member of their sister group would mean getting to appear on TV and put on a lot of shows.

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Airi
rows.Line: Also, I really like the concept they came up with for this group!

rows.Speaker: Airi's Mother
rows.Line: Oh, they've already come up with a concept?

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Airi
rows.Line: Yup! Everyone in Afternoon Girls is really cool and mature, so this group's gonna be more cute and cheerful.

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Airi
rows.Line: And their goal is gonna be to make all of Japan smile! Just like my dream!

rows.Speaker: Airi's Mother
rows.Line: That's right. The agency also seems reputable, so I don't have a problem with you auditioning for them.

rows.Speaker: Airi's Mother
rows.Line: Yes, but... Before you go ahead with this, there's something I need to ask you, Airi.

rows.Speaker: Airi's Mother
rows.Line: There are countless others just like you out there who look up to idols and want to become one...

rows.Speaker: Airi's Mother
rows.Line: Auditioning for this group means competing against them. Do you understand that?

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Airi
rows.Line: If I want to be chosen, then I'm gonna have to start practicing harder than ever.

rows.Speaker: Airi's Mother
rows.Line: Yes. However, that doesn't mean you're allowed to let your grades slip. Do you promise to work hard in both respects?

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Airi
rows.Line:
I promise...!
I'll start getting even higher grades on my tests!

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Airi
rows.Line: Because... I really want to become an idol.

rows.Speaker: Airi's Mother
rows.Line: I believe in you, Airi, so I'm going to give you all the support I can. Let's do our best on this audition!

rows.Speaker: Airi's Mother
rows.Line:
Hehe. Aren't I?
Anyway, let's start by finding more information about this audition, shall we?

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Airi
rows.Line: Okay! Let's see... The first step is to send in an application and have them review it...

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Airi
rows.Line: (I'm glad Mom and I worked so hard coming up with answers to those questions!)

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Airi
rows.Line: (But I can't let my guard down, since I still have to pass the second round...)

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Airi
rows.Line: (I've gotta sing and dance in a way that totally blows the judges away!)

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Airi
rows.Line:
I'll start by practicing my dance moves.
One, two, three...

rows.Speaker: Lead Bully
rows.Line:
Hey, check it out.
The monster's dancing.

rows.Speaker: Neighborhood Bully A
rows.Line: Whoa, you're right. And why are you wearing a skirt?! You look so stupid in that thing.

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Airi
rows.Line:
Nobody asked you!
I'm allowed to wear whatever I want!

rows.Speaker: Neighborhood Bully B
rows.Line:
Wait, you made her mad!
We gotta run before she starts hitting us!

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Airi
rows.Line: (They haven't changed a bit since we were little.)

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Airi
rows.Line: (Are they still bitter about the way I punished them for picking on my little sister?)

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Airi
rows.Line: (But what they say doesn't matter right now...!)

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Airi
rows.Line:
Now, where was I?
One, two, three, four...

rows.Speaker: Airi's Mother
rows.Line: Are you hungry, Airi? Food's ready.

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Airi
rows.Line:
That audition...
You helped me prepare for it so much, Mom.

rows.Speaker: Airi's Mother
rows.Line:
You don't have to apologize.
I know that you did your absolute best, dear.

rows.Speaker: Airi's Mother
rows.Line: The judges even praised you for trying so hard, remember?

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Airi
rows.Line: But... But that isn't good enough!

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Airi
rows.Line: Because I wanna become a dazzling idol!

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Airi
rows.Line: Being praised for trying hard won't make me happy! I have to blow them away with my aura...!

rows.Speaker: Airi's Mother
rows.Line: I see... Then, you'll need to eat up and try again.

rows.Speaker: Airi's Mother
rows.Line: I mean, you're going to have to practice quite a lot if you want to dazzle people as an idol, yes?

rows.Speaker: Airi's Mother
rows.Line: So first, you need to eat properly.

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Airi
rows.Line: Alright, time to start over from scratch!

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Airi
rows.Line: (My next audition is all lined up, so I've gotta do everything I can to pass!)

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Airi
rows.Line: (Starting by reviewing the dance routine Mom helped me fix.)

rows.Speaker: Lead Bully
rows.Line: It's impossible for a monster like you to ever become an idol.

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Airi
rows.Line: You guys are always pestering me like this... Guess you've got nothing better to do!

rows.Speaker: Neighborhood Bully A
rows.Line:
Huh? We do too.
We're on our way to baseball practice.

rows.Speaker: Lead Bully
rows.Line:
Let's go.
We don't want her to beat us up before that tournament.

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Airi
rows.Line: I can too become an idol...

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Airi
rows.Line: (It's not going to be easy, but it's not impossible...)

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Airi
rows.Line: (No matter how hard a dance is, do it with a dazzling smile!)

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Airi
rows.Line: (I have to think about everybody who's watching me, and accomplish something other than just trying hard.)

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Airi
rows.Line: Do, mi, so, do, so, mi, do.

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Airi
rows.Line: No... Every time I go for a high note, I end up sounding a little funny...

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Airi
rows.Line: I have to figure out a way to hit those high notes while still sounding cute!

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Airi
rows.Line: Relax your throat and try again...!

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Airi
rows.Line: (This is really hard... But I'm so close to the end...!)

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Airi
rows.Line: I've gotta sprint to the finish line!!

rows.Speaker: Neighborhood Bully A
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Why'd we have to play against the Gowan Yankees in the first round?

rows.Speaker: Neighborhood Bully B
rows.Line:
They're always winning tournaments, right?
We never stood a chance...

rows.Speaker: Neighborhood Bully A
rows.Line:
I heard she failed her last audition.
But she still hasn't given up...

rows.Speaker: Lead Bully
rows.Line: I'm gonna go back and practice.

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Airi
rows.Line: (I still have some time left until the audition.)

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Airi
rows.Line:
(I have to keep doing everything I can!
And then...)

rows.Speaker: Applicant
rows.Line: Present! Thank you for having me!

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Airi
rows.Line: (I'll be fine. I've come up with good talking points for myself, and I worked a ton on my singing and dancing.)

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Airi
rows.Line: Thank you for having me. My lovely smile is going to brighten up your day!

rows.Speaker: Judge
rows.Line: Now, if you'll sing the song we've assigned.

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Airi
rows.Line:
(I guess it's taking them a while to decide.
Everybody was really good...)

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Airi
rows.Line: (But I also did a good job.)

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Airi
rows.Line: (I made a couple small mistakes here and there, but I was able to introduce myself with a big smile...)

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Airi
rows.Line: (So... So, I'm sure I did fine.)

rows.Speaker: Judge
rows.Line: Thank you all for being so patient.

rows.Speaker: Judge
rows.Line: I will now be announcing the results of our audition. When I call your name, please raise your hand and indicate your presence.

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Airi
rows.Line:
(I worked so hard... I practiced so much...
I did everything I could...)

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Airi
rows.Line: (But I still ended up failing... I didn't know it would hurt this much.)

rows.Speaker: Airi's Mother
rows.Line: Your singing and dancing have both improved so much since your last audition.

rows.Speaker: Airi's Mother
rows.Line: There's no denying that you've grown a lot. So, try to have confidence in yourself.

rows.Speaker: Neighborhood Bully A
rows.Line: Darn it! We were so close!

rows.Speaker: Lead Bully
rows.Line: I know. We're gonna get even better and win next time for sure!

rows.Speaker: Lead Bully
rows.Line:
Anyway, I'll see you tomorrow.
Don't be late for practice!

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Airi
rows.Line:
What is it...?
I don't have time for this right now...

rows.Speaker: Lead Bully
rows.Line: We were up against a really strong team today, but we put up a good fight until the end.

rows.Speaker: Lead Bully
rows.Line:
You just kept on practicing, right?
You never stopped working on your singing and dancing.

rows.Speaker: Lead Bully
rows.Line:
After seeing that...
I thought I should be doing the same thing.

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Airi
rows.Line: Seriously, what was that all about...?

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Airi
rows.Line: I think I'm glad I kept trying so hard.

rows.Speaker: Airi's Sister
rows.Line:
Sis, wake up!
Everyone's already done eating breakfast!

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Airi
rows.Line:
Mhm...
Just a little bit longer...

rows.Speaker: Airi's Sister
rows.Line:
What?! But that show's about to start.
I know we have it set to record, but...

rows.Speaker: Airi's Sister
rows.Line: Yeah, you said you were really looking forward to watching it! What was it called? Close-up Professional, right?

rows.Speaker: Narrator
rows.Line: <The professional we'll be covering this week is the ever-popular idol, Hiyori!>

rows.Speaker: Narrator
rows.Line: <From her private life to everything backstage, we'll be taking a close look at what it's really like to be a brilliant idol!>

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Airi
rows.Line: (I get to see what Hiyori's like when she's not working...!)

rows.Speaker: Narrator
rows.Line: <This day begins with a meeting for a show.>

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Airi
rows.Line: (Oh, there's Hiyori! Even her day-to-day clothes are cute...!)

rows.Speaker: Staff Member
rows.Line: <I see. It would be good to include that song. Anything else you'd like to suggest?>

rows.Speaker: Hiyori
rows.Line: <It's a big venue, so I want to help everyone in the back feel like they're right near the stage.>

rows.Speaker: Hiyori
rows.Line: <I could try going out to the stands more than usual, and throwing some signed balls... I wanna do stuff to make them feel seen.>

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Airi
rows.Line: (I didn't know this was how you planned for shows...)

rows.Speaker: Hiyori
rows.Line: <Yes! My show's coming up, so I've been requesting night practices lately.>

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Airi
rows.Line: (Wait, but she just got out of that meeting!)

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Airi
rows.Line: (When does she take breaks and stuff...?)

rows.Speaker: Instructor
rows.Line: <Alright, let's have you go through your new song from the top.>

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Airi
rows.Line:
(Her moves are so sharp!
She really is an amazing dancer...!)

rows.Speaker: Instructor
rows.Line: <You need to exaggerate each movement more, and express what you're feeling more clearly. No one is going to pay attention if you don't dance with more energy.>

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Airi
rows.Line: She got scolded? But she was so good...

rows.Speaker: Instructor
rows.Line: <Don't look down! You need to constantly focus on connecting with your audience!>

rows.Speaker: Narrator
rows.Line: <This is the day of her new song's release event. During the meet-and-greet portion, she has a chance to shake hands with her fans.>

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Airi
rows.Line: (Oh, I've been to one of her meet-and-greets before...!)

rows.Speaker: Hiyori
rows.Line:
<You're coming to see my show?
Thank you so much! I'm looking forward to seeing you there!>

rows.Speaker: Hiyori
rows.Line:
<Wow, your ribbon's adorable!
You wanted to match the costume for my new song? That's so sweet...!>

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Airi
rows.Line: (Just seeing it is making me smile too.)

rows.Speaker: Narrator
rows.Line: <Following her morning session, Hiyori is able to take a break. However...>

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Airi
rows.Line:
(Wait, she's practicing again?
But she just finished doing her meet-and-greet...)

rows.Speaker: Camera Operator
rows.Line:
<You have a pretty tough schedule.
Aren't you tired?>

rows.Speaker: Hiyori
rows.Line: <No, I actually feel very refreshed after getting a chance to speak to my fans!>

rows.Speaker: Narrator
rows.Line: <Lastly, we bring you behind-the-scenes coverage of the day of her show!>

rows.Speaker: Hiyori
rows.Line: <I'm sorry, but can we go over the timing for the start of the song again?!>

rows.Speaker: Hiyori
rows.Line: <I want this show to become an amazing memory for all of you staff as well, and I'll do my best to make that happen.>

rows.Speaker: Hiyori
rows.Line: <So, I look forward to working with you when we do this for real!>

rows.Speaker: Hiyori
rows.Line: <Thank you! I got to see so many of my fans' smiling faces... I really had a wonderful time!>

rows.Speaker: Camera Operator
rows.Line:
<Truly, congratulations.
I feel encouraged after seeing how hard you worked for this.>

rows.Speaker: Camera Operator
rows.Line:
<So, what's your secret?
How are you able to work so hard and keep on going without giving up?>

rows.Speaker: Hiyori
rows.Line:
<Well...
It's not really a secret or anything...>

rows.Speaker: Hiyori
rows.Line: <But I keep telling myself that it's important to have heart.>

rows.Speaker: Hiyori
rows.Line: <My goal is to put smiles on the faces of those who are watching me.>

rows.Speaker: Hiyori
rows.Line: <I want them to look forward to giving the next day their very best.>

rows.Speaker: Hiyori
rows.Line: <I think that's why I'm able to maintain my optimism like this.>

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Airi
rows.Line: (She really wants everyone watching her to smile and be happy...)

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Airi
rows.Line:
I still have so much to learn...
I mean, during those auditions, I was only thinking about myself.

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Airi
rows.Line: I'll never be able to make anyone happy if I don't—

rows.Speaker: Lead Bully
rows.Line:
You just kept on practicing, right?
You never stopped working on your singing and dancing.

rows.Speaker: Lead Bully
rows.Line:
After seeing that...
I thought I should be doing the same thing.

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Airi
rows.Line: I guess that means I was able to take a small step forward...

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Airi
rows.Line: Towards my dream of becoming a dazzling idol.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: After that, I started placing importance on having heart.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Not just Hiyori, but also the way you took her words and kept trying your best, Airi.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I agree. I didn't realize that you were able to spread hope to others when you were so little.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I mean, it was just a coincidence, so I don't know if it really counts...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But that did give me a huge boost of encouragement.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
I learned that flashy results aren't everything.
Just having a heart full of positivity can be enough to help someone.

rows.Speaker: Arisawa
rows.Line: That is why I think true idols are those who can spread hope simply by being who they are.

rows.Speaker: Arisawa
rows.Line: And most importantly, they must have hearts full of persistent optimism. That is my solemn belief.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Now I get it... That's what it means to spread hope by just being ourselves!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I think I finally understand what Ms. Arisawa was talking about after hearing your story, Airi!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Spreading hope from a stage is one thing, but we need to learn how to spread hope outside of that.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: So, let's do our best during the Lumina Grand Prix.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Because we've been watching you girls for so long.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Despite all the pain and suffering you've had to endure, you kept on trying. You kept on shining bright.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That's why it makes me incredibly happy to think that so many people will watch this program and see how brilliant you are...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
She's right!
After giving up on being idols, you decided to stand back up and form this group.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Even when all those agencies turned you girls down, you started doing streams to spread hope from wherever you could♪

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: While streaming, some of you felt bound to your old personas. But you eventually decided to just be yourselves...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: You did your best to have everyone accept the four of you as MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: As you expanded your activities, you learned how difficult things can be for freelancers. There was also the trouble with managing your schedule.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: And you were given a scare when you stopped receiving offers.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: But you were able to overcome all that by taking hard looks at yourselves and really thinking about your fans.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Because you genuinely want to spread hope to everyone.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: He's right. Your dedication is the reason why you've been able to touch the lives of all your fans. You've even given us quite a lot of hope.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
So, to us...
You girls are the best idols ever.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Be proud of your work, be true to yourselves and keep spreading hope to as many people as you can!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe... After hearing what you guys had to say, I really feel like we've got this!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It's gonna be a fierce competition with lots of tough opponents. I'm sure we're going to run up against some big walls.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But we just need to keep spreading hope with all we have!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Anyway, now that we've received some nice words of encouragement, let's start training for it!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
You're starting to slow down, Minori!
Keep swinging your arms!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You need to relax your upper body more, Shizuku! Try to stay loose!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Nice work! Three more laps to go!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Haha. MEIKO makes for a tough drill sergeant...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
You can do it, girls!
Go, go, MORE MORE JUMP♪

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: For today's talk-show lesson, I'm going to have you come up with funny one-liners on the spot to improve your thinking speed and cleverness.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
So, here's your first question!
“In a previous life, this cat was an idol! How could you tell?”

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I know! Because it's really cute!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hmm... Speed and confidence are important, but that's a bit of a weak response since cats are cute to begin with.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Umm... What if it's because it kneads in a rhythmical manner?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: O-Oh no... My heart's melting just imagining that...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Leave it to Haruka to come up with a tough workout. Having planks at the end really embodies her work ethic.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
(She has her right arm and left leg raised...?
And she's not even out of breath.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Alright, I'm also gonna raise the bar and give it another go...!)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (But it definitely feels like I've come a long way.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (I've gotta maintain this momentum and keep doing everything I can.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Before I go to bed, I'll stretch, put together another talk-show lesson plan and... Oh, I should take a look at that idol program I recorded.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (This episode was supposed to involve following a popular idol around...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Come to think of it, do I still have the recording of that episode of Close-up Professional...?)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Let's see... I wanna say the DVD Mom burned for me was... Oh, here it is!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It's pretty old... I hope it still plays.

rows.Speaker: Hiyori
rows.Line:
<Okay, that felt pretty good!
I should do another run while it's still fresh in my head...>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
(Hiyori really is an amazing person...
She's always shining so bright.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Just watching her fills me with encouragement!)

rows.Speaker: Hiyori
rows.Line: <My goal is to put smiles on the faces of those who are watching me.>

rows.Speaker: Hiyori
rows.Line: <I want them to look forward to giving the next day their very best.>

rows.Speaker: Hiyori
rows.Line: <I think that's why I'm able to maintain my optimism like this.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (That's right. Those were the words that made me...)

rows.Speaker: Camera Operator
rows.Line: <That motto suits you very well, Hiyori.>

rows.Speaker: Hiyori
rows.Line:
<Thank you!
But it's actually another person's words.>

rows.Speaker: Hiyori
rows.Line: <A legendary idol whom I admire very much...>

rows.Speaker: Arisawa
rows.Line: That is why I think true idols are those who can spread hope simply by being who they are.

rows.Speaker: Arisawa
rows.Line: And most importantly, they must have hearts full of persistent optimism. That is my solemn belief.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (I have to do my absolute best...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (I need to put all my heart into creating an unwavering beacon.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (To spread hope to as many people as I can.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: So, I'll give the Lumina Grand Prix everything I've got!
